test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which country has the longest written constitution in the world?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India.**__

__
 
• The Constitution of India is the longest written constitution of any sovereign country in the world, containing 448 articles grouped in 22 parts with 12 schedules.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There were 395 articles originally in the Constitution of India.
 
• Presently 470 articles are there in Constitution.
 
• The Indian Constitution was originally written in **English.**
 
• Prem Behari Narain Raizada wrote the Indian constitution by hand.
 
• Dr. BR Ambedkar is known as the father of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Indian Constitution was adopted by the Constituent Assembly of India on 26 November 1949 and became effective on 26 January 1950.
